remarks: Renovated Kitchen, New carpets, freshly painted, new furnace-AC unit, and ready for move in. Spacious 3 bedroom home in Springdale neighborhood. Large Eat in kitchen with new gas stove, pantry and plenty of cabinets and counterspace. Off the kitchen is the Dining Room for those special celebrations and holidays. The Huge living room completes the picture  There is a guest bath on this level.  The second level has 3 bedrooms and a family bathroom. The spacious Primary bedroom with full bath, double sinks and vanity, also includes a large walk-in closet and a second closet. Many nearby amenities including the Springdale Branch of the Ferguson library, Springdale School and Shopping center, Train, close access to the Merritt Parkway, Twin Rinks, and Post Office to name a few. No PETS. Very Good credit please.
